acceptanceCriteria: A documented, supported closeout route exists for a merged delivery whose sealed map is cited-only, and it gates the delivered code paths (test or recorded live run on one of V1-1694/1695/1665/1697)
`gate run cem-verdict` or a read-only preflight reports no-governed-hunk / tier-below-anchored before an attempt is charged (test)
DOGFOOD.md or the closeout procedure names the route
body: Found 2026-10-18 closing V1-1694/1695/1665/1697 (PR #1100/#1117 deliveries), Corvint 1.0.0-rc.3 build 634. Extends V1-1760, which covers the root (dogfood binds code hunks only 'cited'). Every original sealed map for those four tickets refuses tier-below-anchored (V1-1694: base e1c349d21 seal 39407f669, 27 of 29 hunks cited). The workaround of an anchored build-log addendum (V1-1694: base b26edd021 seal e0a5521cf) refuses CEM_VERDICT_PREDICATE_FAILED no-governed-hunk because claim.verdictPaths come from touchPaths, which exclude docs/build-log/. V1-1681 passed only because its touchPaths include docs/build-log/. Each refusal charges an attempt, and the four tickets are now RETRY_EXHAUSTED with no supported closeout path. Evidence: .git/taskman/evidence/a2ce090096008915089786cfdca7e4f4ed55e5e73a89af3b1d4929e1cf371949; dry-run with `corvint cem gate-verdict` reproduces it exactly. Expected: either the binder can anchor delivered code hunks (V1-1760), or there is one documented closeout route for an already-merged cited-only delivery that checks the delivered code rather than a closeout note, plus a pre-claim dry-run so a doomed gate run does not spend an attempt. Actual: no route; the gate failure spends retries.
title: cem-verdict touched-anchored: the anchored closeout addendum refuses no-governed-hunk when ticket touchPaths exclude docs/build-log/, and the original code maps stay tier-below-anchored
